subject: Acceptance window slipping — updated MAP & exec escalation
messages:
From: Kate Lang <kate.lang@helioshealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi@helioshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance window slipping — need updated MAP & options

Ben —

Quick heads up from Helios: our compliance review pushed out this week, and procurement just told us they can only process invoices starting 2027-09-20. That slides our acceptance window by ~10–14 days unless we change scope. We know this is late in the run, so wanted to surface early.

Two immediate asks:
- Can you send an updated MAP and an evaluation-plan addendum that shows a split acceptance window or a canary plan?
- If we do have to slide the go-live, what mitigation options do you see to keep us in production by Oct 1? (short of full rollback)

We’re trying to avoid broader exec escalation but procurement timing is out of our hands. Ravi and I can join a short call tomorrow to walk through tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Kate Lang
VP, Operations
Helios Health

---
Note: procurement contact Ravi Menon in case you need docs/PO timing details.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Kate Lang <kate.lang@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.example.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@helioshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window slipping — need updated MAP & options

Kate — thanks for the heads-up and for looping Ravi. Very much appreciate the early signal. I hear procurement is the blocker; we can work around that with a narrowly scoped acceptance pattern or a short-lived canary.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) 30-minute alignment call Monday to confirm acceptance criteria and procurement constraints.
2) I’ll ask Camila to prepare a two-path MAP: (A) split acceptance (canary + bulk) that lets you start limited traffic ahead of final PO, (B) full re-baseline with revised milestones and a documented contingency runbook.
3) Grace, can you confirm whether finance/legal are comfortable with a small credit/holdback if the acceptance slips beyond two weeks? If we need exec sign-off we’ll escalate to Jonas.

I’ll schedule the call and share a condensed risk log + the initial MAP stub for quick review.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example.com
(Attachment: Initial_MAP.pdf — high-level milestones and acceptance criteria)

Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Helios acceptance slip — quick risk tally and asks

Camila/Grace —

Looping you both for internal triage. Kate flagged ~10–14 day procurement lag that will push their acceptance window unless we change the plan. Summary risk tally below based on current commitments:

Risk log (short):
- Acceptance slip to 2027-09-22 -> 10 days of push against Oct 1 go-live. Risk: moderate (acceptance gating).
- Procurement freeze until 9/20 -> legal/finance sign-off delayed. Risk: high for revenue recognition.
- Resource drift (our implementation team limited availability from 9/20–9/30). Risk: moderate-high.

Mitigations to prepare:
- Camila: two-path MAP (canary + bulk) + small eval-plan addendum that narrows acceptance criteria for canary. Target: MAP v2 by EOD Monday.
- Grace: confirm whether finance can accept an interim invoice or a provisional PO; if not, what's the earliest payment authorization date? Also check whether a credit cap (e.g., 15–30%) is acceptable if Helios requests an extended acceptance period.
- Ben: I’ll prepare a short escalation note for Jonas if we need exec-level approval on credits/waivers.

Also include a simple attachment list: Initial_MAP.pdf (sent to customer), previous risk log snapshot. Keep this tight — we want to avoid alarming Kate unless we need to escalate.

—Ben

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com>, Kate Lang <kate.lang@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window slipping — MAP v2 and contingency action grid

Ben/Grace/Kate —

Attached are two artifacts: MAP_v2.xlsx (action grid + split acceptance schedule) and EvalPlan_Addendum.docx (narrowed criteria for canary). Highlights below so the thread is scannable:

Proposed MAP v2 (summary):
- Phase 1 (Canary): 09/22–09/28 — limited traffic (10% of sessions), acceptance criteria tightened to 5 core success metrics with 48h hold for regressions. This allows Helios to validate with reduced exposure before full PO clears.
- Phase 2 (Bulk): 09/29–10/05 — full traffic ramp assuming procurement clears by 09/20 and no canary regressions.
- Fallback: If procurement not cleared by 09/20, move bulk to 10/06 and execute contingency runbook (rollback + hotfix window).

Risk log snapshot (new):
- Procurement slip -> revenue deferral risk. Estimated impact: ~$45k ARR for September billing.
- Resource reallocation risk during extended window; mitigation: block-engineer schedule 09/22–10/05.

Ask list:
- Kate / Ravi: confirm procurement earliest date and whether provisional PO is a possibility.
- Grace: please advise on whether finance/legal can support provisional invoicing or a short-term credit cap.
- Ben: if finance requires executive approval for credits/waivers, recommend we escalate today so we’re not waiting.

I’ll be on the alignment call tomorrow with a slide deck (2 slides) to walk through the MAP v2 timeline.

Thanks — attaching MAP_v2.xlsx and EvalPlan_Addendum.docx.

—Camila Reyes
Sr. Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.example.com
(Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, EvalPlan_Addendum.docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.example.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com>, Kate Lang <kate.lang@helioshealth.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@helioshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: [Escalation] Acceptance timetable — ask for exec guidance

Jonas — forwarding a short thread with Helios. Procurement pushed a hard date (earliest 09/20). Camila put together a split MAP (attached) that gives Helios a canary window starting 09/22 and a bulk ramp the week after — provided procurement clears. If procurement remains blocked we risk missing Oct 1 go-live and deferring ~$45k ARR for the period.

Clear asks for exec guidance:
1) Approve temporary credit cap up to 30% to be used only if Helios requires a formal shifted acceptance window (we’d apply as a single-month credit to September invoice).
2) Alternatively, sign off on the canary + provisional PO approach (legal/finance waiver) to let Helios begin limited traffic prior to full invoicing.

If you prefer, I can summarize in one pager for a quick sign-off. Camila/Grace — please add anything I missed re: resource or legal constraints. Kate/Ravi — we’ll keep you posted; want to avoid unnecessary escalation on your side but may need short exec approval to keep the Oct 1 outcome viable.

Ben Carter
Principal AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.example.com
(Forwarded attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, EvalPlan_Addendum.docx, Initial_MAP.pdf)
